method: Physical tracked-doc scratch copy; remove effective oldPaths, retain existing destinations without invented carriage, then run the existing enumerator/pure generator. Rejoin ALL 9,650 preserves. Every member must state a reason; moving operands require source-confirmed history/fixture/key semantics or explicit whole-gate retirement. Role is diagnostic only, never an exemption. Any unconfirmed premise patches to an exact successor or parks with a named owner/blocker. No runtime/carriage parity claimed.

premiseDescriptions.unchanged-operand-outside-move-set: The effective move simulation does not remove any literal target in this operand. This confirms only the existing reason’s operand-stability premise, not target existence or runtime parity.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-historical-text: The pinned passage confirms the stated historical/capture premise; candidate target removal is expected for a historical coordinate, not an operative document read.
premiseDescriptions.agents-cutover-packet: L12-121 supersedes L12-60 for these seven root pointers only: the simulated move removes their current targets.
premiseDescriptions.live-pointer-retention-premise-overturne: L12-121: present-tense pointer loses its literal target in the candidate tree; compose its exact successor replacement with every same-file hunk.
premiseDescriptions.gateway-fixture-co-cut: Existing prepared gateway-contract-reader-move already changes the real runtime contract path; fixture writers must co-change with it, including create_dir_all parent. Preserve is inconsistent with that co-cut.
premiseDescriptions.conditional-r28-preserve-overturned: The member explicitly preserves only pending retention-or-move decision. Effective move set retires the operand; apply the recorded conditional pointer co-cut, without changing prose semantics.
premiseDescriptions.additional-live-pointer-overturned: No historical/fixture premise is confirmed by source; the literal target disappears and has one exact existing successor. Compose the pointer patch, without semantic prose/schema changes.
premiseDescriptions.architecture-map-dependent-park: Manifest map field is a live pointer to a removed target; it depends on the existing architecture-map content/heading-carriage park, not a retained-root premise.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-historical-root-text: The root/glob is recorded historical design or proof text in the pinned source, not a claim that the retired root remains a live input.

premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-document-history: Correction to the old retained-path explanation: the operand is in explicit Document history and its surviving knowledge copy preserves capture identity, not a live path.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-immutable-fixture: Pinned immutable dogfood scenario records original MVP2 behavior; candidate removal changes no fixture input/read.
premiseDescriptions.source-already-retired-at-pin: The physical source is already absent at the explicit pin; no live operand is retained or read in the simulated tree. Historical identity remains in its owning record.
premiseDescriptions.unconfirmed-preserve-premise-parked: The recorded preserve premise is not confirmed by the candidate tree/source. No unique eligible replacement is bound; preserve is overturned to an individually owned blocker.
premiseDescriptions.unconfirmed-scan-description-parked: The source comment describes a live scan of retiring roots, not dated text; conditional co-cut is still uncomposed.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-legacy-membership-token: The pinned migration gate compares inventory/path strings against the OLD root identity. Removing physical documents does not rename the old-root membership predicate; no retained-file claim is made.
premiseDescriptions.frozen-data-retires-with-gate: Exact key remains in pinned frozen data; the named Decision F retirement park removes this data and its gate together. No claim that the key resolves after cutover.
premiseDescriptions.original-frozen-key-already-removed: Original frozen key is verified at its census pin and absent from current pinned bytes; no post-move lookup survives. This corrects the stale retained-key premise without rebasing or recreating data.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-gate-retirement: This is the frozen ratchet’s old-root policy/comment; its named Decision F unit retires the script with the data, not just its directory operands.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-retirement-example: The literal is inside an example explicitly saying the old path retires in favor of docs/platform, not a surviving target claim.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-inventory-key: RECONCILIATION filters existing inventory rowsByPath; it does not dereference a candidate-tree document. The old inventory key is intentionally unchanged.
premiseDescriptions.unconfirmed-root-premise-parked: A root/wrapped operand needs its own source-confirmed premise; no role-based or outside-exact-file exemption is granted.
premiseDescriptions.real-manifest-demo-moved: Regenerated manifest no longer has the old demo entry. Compose both assertions with the direct frontmatter hunk and REAL_DEMO_DOC_PATH.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-test-title: The exact operand occurs inside a test title, not a filesystem reader; the owning co-cut dependency remains separate.
premiseDescriptions.source-confirmed-synthetic-path: The widget path is a synthetic compared prompt string, absent in both trees; it is not a moved physical document.
